steps.en: The officer opens the work item and compares old and new address
steps.id: Petugas membuka work item dan membandingkan alamat lama dan baru
steps.why_en: No work item screen exists; the officer only sees the old address after typing the ID.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar work item; petugas hanya melihat alamat lama setelah mengetik ID.

steps.en: The officer decides whether to lift the indicator
steps.why_en: Lifting works from a staff screen, but keeping is not recorded and the deciding officer's name is not saved.
steps.why_id: Pencabutan bisa dari layar staf, tetapi keputusan tetap tidak dicatat dan nama petugas yang memutuskan tidak tersimpan.

steps.en: The officer decides to resend the reminder to the new address
steps.id: Petugas memutuskan mengirim ulang reminder ke alamat baru
steps.why_en: There is no separate resend choice; pressing lift only implies it, and automatic letter generation is switched off in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pilihan kirim ulang terpisah; menekan cabut hanya menyiratkannya, dan pembuatan surat otomatis dimatikan di code.

steps.en: OCMS shows a confirmation that the decision was accepted
steps.id: OCMS menampilkan konfirmasi bahwa keputusan diterima
